title: Rollover Gap Adjustment in Small Business Electricity Supply Grace-Period Renewal Pricing
content:
**Rollover-gap adjustment.** For a Small Business Electricity Supply agreement renewed inside the grace period after rollover, the final options notice's month-to-month rate minus its renewal rate is the rollover gap; a gap of 2.50 cents or more takes 0.06 cents per kWh off the grace-period renewal rate; a gap of at least 1.00 but under 2.50 cents takes 0.03 cents off; a smaller gap takes nothing off.

Both rates are read from the same final options notice, the latest by notice date where more than one is on record.

| Rollover gap (month-to-month rate less renewal rate) | Rollover-gap adjustment |
|---|---|
| 2.50 cents or more | 0.06 cents per kWh off |
| 1.00 cents to under 2.50 cents | 0.03 cents per kWh off |
| under 1.00 cent | nothing off |

**Hypothetical notices**

| Month-to-month rate | Renewal rate | Gap | Adjustment |
|---|---|---|---|
| 11.90 | 9.20 | 2.70 | 0.06 cents off |
| 11.70 | 9.20 | 2.50 | 0.06 cents off |
| 11.69 | 9.20 | 2.49 | 0.03 cents off |
| 10.20 | 9.20 | 1.00 | 0.03 cents off |
| 10.19 | 9.20 | 0.99 | nothing off |
